title: pane socket line
description: One line that loam hook writes to LOAM_PANE_SOCKET. It is not output of a loam command. The app must ignore events that it does not know.

source.description: Only on SessionStart (startup, resume, clear, compact, fork) and UserPromptSubmit (what started the turn, such as user or system). Claude Code does not send it on UserPromptSubmit today.

notification_type.description: Only on Notification: elicitation_dialog, elicitation_url_dialog, agent_needs_input, permission_prompt, elicitation_response, or elicitation_complete.
